entities.description: A young boy with short, messy blonde hair and freckles on his face is smiling gently while leaning his head against an older man's shoulder. He is wearing a white polo shirt with dark blue trim on the collar and sleeves, and dark blue jeans.

An elderly man with white hair and a young boy with blonde hair sit closely together on a wooden bench, both wearing matching white polo shirts with dark blue trim on the collars and sleeves. The man has his arm around the boy, who leans his head against the man's shoulder, both displaying gentle smiles in a sunlit park setting.
